verses.he: כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וּנְתָנ֞וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ בְּיָדֶ֖ךָ וְשָׁבִ֥יתָ שִׁבְיֽוֹ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִפּוֹק לַאֲגָחָא קְרָבָא עַל בַּעֲלֵי דְבָבָךְ וְיִמְסְרִנוּן יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ בִּידָךְ וְתִשְׁבֵּי שִׁבְיְהוֹן
verses.en: If you should go to war against your enemies, and Adonoy, your God, puts them in your hand, and you capture prisoners from them;

oe.t: If you should go to [
wage
] war against your enemies, and Adonoy, your God, puts them in your hand, and you capture prisoners from them;

verses.he: וְרָאִיתָ֙ בַּשִּׁבְיָ֔ה אֵ֖שֶׁת יְפַת־תֹּ֑אַר וְחָשַׁקְתָּ֣ בָ֔הּ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ לְךָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.on: וְתֶחֱזֵי בְּשִׁבְיָה אִתְּתָא שַׁפִּירַת חֵזוּ וְתִתִּרְעֵי בַהּ וְתִסְבַהּ לָךְ לְאִנְתּוּ
verses.en: And you see among the prisoners a beautifully formed woman; if you desire her, you may take her as your wife.

oe.t: And you see among the prisoners a beautifully formed woman; if you desire her, you may take her as your wife.

verses.he: וַהֲבֵאתָ֖הּ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְגִלְּחָה֙ אֶת־רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה אֶת־צִפָּרְנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.on: וְתָעֵלִנַהּ לְגוֹ בֵיתָךְ וּתְגַלַח יָת רֵישַׁהּ וּתְרַבִּי יָת טוּפְרָנָהָא
verses.en: You will bring her into your house and she will shave her head and allow her nails to grow.

oe.t: You will bring her into your house and she will shave her head and allow her nails to grow.

verses.he: וְהֵסִ֩ירָה֩ אֶת־שִׂמְלַ֨ת שִׁבְיָ֜הּ מֵעָלֶ֗יהָ וְיָֽשְׁבָה֙ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ וּבָֽכְתָ֛ה אֶת־אָבִ֥יהָ וְאֶת־אִמָּ֖הּ יֶ֣רַח יָמִ֑ים וְאַ֨חַר כֵּ֜ן תָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וּבְעַלְתָּ֔הּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.on: וְתֶעְדֵי יָת כְּסוּת שִׁבְיַהּ מִנַהּ וְתֵיתַב בְּבֵיתָךְ וְתִבְכֵּי יָת אֲבוּהָא וְיָת אִמַהּ יְרַח יוֹמִין וּבָתַר כֵּן תֵּיעוּל לְוָתַהּ וְתִבְעֲלִנַהּ וּתְהֵי לָךְ לְאִנְתּוּ
verses.en: She must discard her prisoner’s garb from upon her, and she will remain in your home and weep for her father and her mother a month of days; and afterwards you may come to her and consummate with her, and she will become your wife.

oe.t: She must discard her prisoner’s garb from upon her, and she will remain in your home and weep for her father and her mother a month of days; and afterwards you may come to her and consummate with her, and she will become your wife.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־לֹ֧א חָפַ֣צְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְשִׁלַּחְתָּהּ֙ לְנַפְשָׁ֔הּ וּמָכֹ֥ר לֹא־תִמְכְּרֶ֖נָּה בַּכָּ֑סֶף לֹא־תִתְעַמֵּ֣ר בָּ֔הּ תַּ֖חַת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִנִּיתָֽהּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וִיהֵי אִם לָא תִתִּרְעֵי בַהּ וְתִפְטְּרִנַהּ לְנַפְשַׁהּ וְזַבָּנָא לָא תְזַבְּנִנַהּ בְּכַסְפָּא לָא תִתָּגַר בַּהּ חֳלַף דִי עִינִיתַהּ
verses.en: But it shall come to pass, that if you do not desire her you will send her free, but to sell—you may not sell her for money; you may not exploit her since you have oppressed her.

oe.t: But it shall come to pass, that if you do not desire her you will send her free, but to sell—you may not sell her for money; you may not exploit her since you have oppressed her.

verses.he: כִּֽי־תִהְיֶ֨יןָ לְאִ֜ישׁ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֗ים הָאַחַ֤ת אֲהוּבָה֙ וְהָאַחַ֣ת שְׂנוּאָ֔ה וְיָֽלְדוּ־ל֣וֹ בָנִ֔ים הָאֲהוּבָ֖ה וְהַשְּׂנוּאָ֑ה וְהָיָ֛ה הַבֵּ֥ן הַבְּכ֖וֹר לַשְּׂנִיאָֽה׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תְהֶוְיָן לִגְבַר תַּרְתֵּין נְשִׁין חֲדָא רְחֶמְתָּא וַחֲדָא שְׂנִיאֲתָא וִילִידָן לֵהּ בְּנִין רְחֶמְתָּא וּשְׂנִיאֲתָא וִיהֵי בְּרָא בוּכְרָא לִשְׂנִיאֲתָא
verses.en: If a man has two wives, one loved and the other hated, and they bear him sons, the loved [one] and the hated [one], and the firstborn son will be the hated one’s.

oe.t: If a man has two wives, one loved and the other hated, and they bear him sons, the loved [one] and the hated [one], and the firstborn son will be the hated one’s.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ הַנְחִיל֣וֹ אֶת־בָּנָ֔יו אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֖ה ל֑וֹ לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל לְבַכֵּר֙ אֶת־בֶּן־הָ֣אֲהוּבָ֔ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י בֶן־הַשְּׂנוּאָ֖ה הַבְּכֹֽר׃
verses.on: וִיהֵי בְּיוֹמָא דְיַחְסֵן לִבְנוֹהִי יָת דִי יְהֵי לֵהּ לֵית לֵהּ רְשׁוּ לְבַכָּרָא יָת בַּר רְחֶמְתָּא עַל אַפֵּי בַר שְׂנִיאֲתָא בּוּכְרָא
verses.en: When the day comes for him to will to his sons what he owns, he may not prefer the son of the loved one over the son of the hated one—the firstborn.

oe.t: When the day comes for him to will to his sons what he owns, he may not prefer the son of the loved one over the son of the hated one—the firstborn.

verses.he: כִּי֩ אֶת־הַבְּכֹ֨ר בֶּן־הַשְּׂנוּאָ֜ה יַכִּ֗יר לָ֤תֶת לוֹ֙ פִּ֣י שְׁנַ֔יִם בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יִמָּצֵ֖א ל֑וֹ כִּי־הוּא֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית אֹנ֔וֹ ל֖וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי יָת בּוּכְרָא בַר שְׂנִיאֲתָא יַפְרַשׁ לְמִתַּן לֵהּ תַּרְתֵּין חָלָקִין בְּכֹל דִי יִשְׁתְּכַח לֵהּ אֲרֵי הוּא רֵישׁ תָּקְפֵּהּ לֵהּ חָזְיָא בְכֵרוּתָא
verses.en: Rather, the firstborn son of the hated one is he to recognize to give him doublefold of all that he possesses; for he is the first of his power, he has the rights of primogeniture.

oe.t: Rather, the firstborn son of the hated one is he to recognize [
separate
] to give him doublefold of all that he possesses; for he is the first of his power, he has the rights of primogeniture.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֣ה לְאִ֗ישׁ בֵּ֚ן סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמוֹרֶ֔ה אֵינֶ֣נּוּ שֹׁמֵ֔עַ בְּק֥וֹל אָבִ֖יו וּבְק֣וֹל אִמּ֑וֹ וְיסְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יְהֵי לִגְבַר בַּר סָטֵי וּמָרֵי לֵיתוֹהִי מְקַבַּל לְמֵימַר אֲבוּהִי וּלְמֵימַר אִמֵהּ וּמַלְפָן יָתֵהּ וְלָא יְקַבֵּל מִנְהוֹן
verses.en: If a man has a wayward and rebellious son who does not obey his father and his mother; though they chasten him; he does not listen to them.

oe.t: If a man has a wayward and rebellious son who does not obey his father[
’s words
] and his mother[
’s words
]; though they chasten [
teach
] him; he does not listen to [
obey
] them.

verses.he: וְתָ֥פְשׂוּ ב֖וֹ אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ וְהוֹצִ֧יאוּ אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־זִקְנֵ֥י עִיר֖וֹ וְאֶל־שַׁ֥עַר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱדוּן בֵּהּ אֲבוּהִי וְאִמֵּהּ וְיַפְּקוּן יָתֵהּ לָקֳדָם סָבֵי קַרְתֵּהּ וְלִתְרַע בֵּית דִין אַתְרֵהּ
verses.en: His father and mother are to grasp him and take him out to the judges of his city and to the court in his location.

oe.t: His father and mother are to grasp him and take him out to [
before
] the judges of his city and to the court in his location.

verses.he: וְאָמְר֞וּ אֶל־זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֗וֹ בְּנֵ֤נוּ זֶה֙ סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמֹרֶ֔ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ בְּקֹלֵ֑נוּ זוֹלֵ֖ל וְסֹבֵֽא׃
verses.on: וְיֵימְרוּן לְסָבֵי קַרְתֵּהּ בְּנָנָא דֵין סָטֵי וּמָרֵי לֵיתוֹהִי מְקַבֵּל לְמֵימְרָנָא זָלֵל בְּסָר וְסָבֵי חֲמַר
verses.en: They will say to the judges of his city, ‘‘This son of ours is wayward and rebellious—he does not obey—gluttonous and drunken.’’

oe.t: They will say to the judges of his city, ‘‘This son of ours is wayward and rebellious—he does not obey [
our words
]—gluttonous [
with meat
] and drunken [
with wine

verses.he: וּ֠רְגָמֻהוּ כָּל־אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִיר֤וֹ בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ וָמֵ֔ת וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁמְע֥וּ וְיִרָֽאוּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְיִרְגְמֻנֵהּ כָּל אֶנָשֵׁי קַרְתֵּהּ בְּאַבְנַיָא וִימוּת וּתְפַלֵי עָבֵד דְבִישׁ מִבֵּינָךְ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל יִשְׁמְעוּן וְיִדְחֲלוּן
verses.en: And all the men of his city will stone him with stones so that he dies, and you will eliminate the evil within you; and let all Yisroel hear and be fearful.

oe.t: And all the men of his city will stone him with stones so that he dies, and you will eliminate the evil [
doers
] within you; and let all Yisroel hear and be fearful.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יִהְיֶ֣ה בְאִ֗ישׁ חֵ֛טְא מִשְׁפַּט־מָ֖וֶת וְהוּמָ֑ת וְתָלִ֥יתָ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־עֵֽץ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי יְהֵי בִגְבַר חוֹבַת דִין דִקְטוֹל וְיִתְקְטֵל וְתִצְלוֹב יָתֵהּ עַל צְלִיבָא
verses.en: If a man is guilty of a capital offense and is executed; you shall hang him from a tree.

oe.t: If a man is guilty of a capital offense and is executed; you shall hang [
crucify
] him from a tree [
on a crucifix

verses.he: לֹא־תָלִ֨ין נִבְלָת֜וֹ עַל־הָעֵ֗ץ כִּֽי־קָב֤וֹר תִּקְבְּרֶ֙נּוּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כִּֽי־קִלְלַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים תָּל֑וּי וְלֹ֤א תְטַמֵּא֙ אֶת־אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תְבִית נְבִלְתֵּהּ עַל צְלִיבָא אֲרֵי מִקְבַּר תִּקְבְּרִנֵהּ בְּיוֹמָא הַהוּא אֲרֵי עַל דְחָב קֳדָם יְיָ אִצְטְלַב וְלָא תְסָאֵב יָת אַרְעָךְ דִי יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ יָהֵב לָךְ אַחֲסָנָא
verses.en: Do not leave his corpse overnight on the tree, but you are surely to bury him on that day, for a hanging corpse is an affront to God; so do not defile your land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you as territory.

oe.t: Do not leave his corpse overnight on the tree [
crucifix
], but you are surely to bury him on that day, for a hanging corpse is an affront to God [
for he was crucified because he sinned before Hashem
]; so do not defile your land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you as territory.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תִרְאֶה֩ אֶת־שׁ֨וֹר אָחִ֜יךָ א֤וֹ אֶת־שֵׂיוֹ֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֥ב תְּשִׁיבֵ֖ם לְאָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.on: לָא תֶחֱזֵי יָת תּוֹרָא דְאָחוּךְ אוֹ יַת אִמְרֵהּ דְטָעָן וְתִתְכְּבֵשׁ מִנְהוֹן אָתָבָא תָתֵבִנוּן לְאָחוּךְ
verses.en: You may not observe your brother’s ox or his sheep lost and conceal yourself from them; you must surely return them to your brother.

oe.t: You may not observe your brother’s ox or his sheep lost and conceal yourself from them; you must surely return them to your brother.

verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֨א קָר֥וֹב אָחִ֛יךָ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א יְדַעְתּ֑וֹ וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְהָיָ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ עַ֣ד דְּרֹ֤שׁ אָחִ֙יךָ֙ אֹת֔וֹ וַהֲשֵׁבֹת֖וֹ לֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם לָא קָרֵב אֲחוּךְ לְוָתָךְ וְלָא יְדַעַתְּ לֵהּ וְתַכְנְשִׁנֵהּ לְגוֹ בֵיתָךְ וִיהֵי עִמָךְ עַד דְיִתְבַּע אֲחוּךְ יָתֵהּ וְתָתֵיבִנֵהּ לֵהּ
verses.en: But if your brother is not near you or you do not know him, gather it into your house and let it stay with you until your brother seeks it, when you must return it to him.

oe.t: But if your brother is not near you or you do not know him, gather it into your house and let it stay with you until your brother seeks it, when you must return it to him.

verses.he: וְכֵ֧ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לַחֲמֹר֗וֹ וְכֵ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ לְשִׂמְלָתוֹ֒ וְכֵ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֜ה לְכָל־אֲבֵדַ֥ת אָחִ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאבַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וּמְצָאתָ֑הּ לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לְהִתְעַלֵּֽם׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְכֵן תַּעְבֵּד לַחֲמָרֵהּ וְכֵן תַּעְבֵּד לִכְסוּתֵהּ וְכֵן תַּעְבֵּד לְכָל אֲבֵדַת אֲחוּךְ דִי תֵיבַד מִנֵהּ וְתַשְׁכְּחִנַהּ לֵית לָךְ רְשׁוּ לְאִתְכַּסָאָה
verses.en: And so are you to do for his donkey, and so are you to do for his garment, and so are you to do for any lost object of your brother’s that is lost from him which you find. You may not conceal yourself.

oe.t: And so are you to do for his donkey, and so are you to do for his garment, and so are you to do for any lost object of your brother’s that is lost from him which you find. You may not [
have no permission to
] conceal yourself.

verses.he: לֹא־תִרְאֶה֩ אֶת־חֲמ֨וֹר אָחִ֜יךָ א֤וֹ שׁוֹרוֹ֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם הָקֵ֥ם תָּקִ֖ים עִמּֽוֹ׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תֶחֱזֵי יָת חֲמָרָא דְאָחוּךְ אוֹ תוֹרֵהּ רָמָן בְּאָרְחָא וְתִתְכְּבֵשׁ מִנְהוֹן אֲקָמָא תְקִים עִמֵהּ
verses.en: Do not observe your brother’s donkey or his ox collapsing on the road and ignore them. You must surely lift it up with him.

oe.t: Do not observe your brother’s donkey or his ox collapsing on the road and ignore them. You must surely lift it up with him.

verses.he: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֤ה כְלִי־גֶ֙בֶר֙ עַל־אִשָּׁ֔ה וְלֹא־יִלְבַּ֥שׁ גֶּ֖בֶר שִׂמְלַ֣ת אִשָּׁ֑ה כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כָּל־עֹ֥שֵׂה אֵֽלֶּה׃ (פ)
verses.on: לָא יְהֵי תִקוּן זֵין דִגְבַר עַל אִתְּתָא וְלָא יְתַקֵן גְבַר בְּתִקוּנֵי אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי מְרָחָק קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ כָּל עָבֵד אִלֵין
verses.en: A man’s attire may not be on a woman nor may a man wear a woman’s garment; for the abomination of Adonoy, your God, are all who do these [things].

oe.t: A man’s attire [
weapons
] may not be on a woman nor may a man wear [
adorn himself with
] a woman’s garment [
adornments
]; for the abomination of [
are distanced before
] Adonoy, your God, are all who do these [things].

verses.he: כִּ֣י יִקָּרֵ֣א קַן־צִפּ֣וֹר ׀ לְפָנֶ֡יךָ בַּדֶּ֜רֶךְ בְּכָל־עֵ֣ץ ׀ א֣וֹ עַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶפְרֹחִים֙ א֣וֹ בֵיצִ֔ים וְהָאֵ֤ם רֹבֶ֙צֶת֙ עַל־הָֽאֶפְרֹחִ֔ים א֖וֹ עַל־הַבֵּיצִ֑ים לֹא־תִקַּ֥ח הָאֵ֖ם עַל־הַבָּנִֽים׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יְעָרַע קִנָא דְצִפְּרָא קֳדָמָךְ בְּאָרְחָא בְּכָל אִילָן אוֹ עַל אַרְעָא אֶפְרוֹחִין אוֹ בֵיעִין וְאִמָא רְבֵעָא עַל אֶפְרֹחִין אוֹ עַל בֵּיעִין לָא תִסַב אִמָא עַל בְּנַיָא
verses.en: If you should chance upon a bird’s nest before you on the road in any tree, or on the ground, [with] fledglings or eggs, and the mother is sitting on the fledglings or on the eggs; do not take the mother with her offspring.

oe.t: If you should chance upon a bird’s nest before you on the road in any tree, or on the ground, [with] fledglings or eggs, and the mother is sitting on the fledglings or on the eggs; do not take the mother with her offspring.

verses.he: שַׁלֵּ֤חַ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־הָאֵ֔ם וְאֶת־הַבָּנִ֖ים תִּֽקַּֽח־לָ֑ךְ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ וְהַאֲרַכְתָּ֖ יָמִֽים׃ (ס)
verses.on: שַׁלָחָא תְשַׁלַח יָת אִמָא וְיָת בְּנַיָא תִּסַב לָךְ בְּדִיל דְיֵיטַב לָךְ וְתוֹרִיךְ יוֹמִין
verses.en: You must surely send away the mother and the offspring take for yourself, so that you will benefit and you will live long.

oe.t: You must surely send away the mother and the offspring take for yourself, so that you will benefit and you will live long.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תִבְנֶה֙ בַּ֣יִת חָדָ֔שׁ וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מַעֲקֶ֖ה לְגַגֶּ֑ךָ וְלֹֽא־תָשִׂ֤ים דָּמִים֙ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־יִפֹּ֥ל הַנֹּפֵ֖ל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִבְנֵי בֵּיתָא חַדְתָּא וְתַעְבֵּד תְּיָקָא לְאִגְרָךְ וְלָא תְשַׁוִי חוֹבַת דִין דִקְטוֹל בְּבֵיתָךְ אֲרֵי יִפֵּל דְנָפֵל מִנֵהּ
verses.en: When you build a new home, you are to make a fence for your roof; and do not place blood [liability] in your house, for someone who should fall may fall from it.

oe.t: When you build a new home, you are to make a fence for your roof; and do not place blood [
death
] [liability] in your house, for someone who should fall may fall from it.

verses.he: לֹא־תִזְרַ֥ע כַּרְמְךָ֖ כִּלְאָ֑יִם פֶּן־תִּקְדַּ֗שׁ הַֽמְלֵאָ֤ה הַזֶּ֙רַע֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּזְרָ֔ע וּתְבוּאַ֖ת הַכָּֽרֶם׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תִזְרַע כַּרְמָךְ עֵרוּבִין דִילְמָא תִסְתָּאַב דִמְעַת זַרְעָא דִי תִזְרַע וַעֲלָלַת כַּרְמָא
verses.en: Do not plant in your vineyard mixed species, lest the expansion become obnoxious—the seed that you plant—and the produce of the vineyard.

oe.t: Do not plant in your vineyard mixed species, lest the expansion become obnoxious [
impure
]—the seed that you plant—and the produce of the vineyard.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תַחֲרֹ֥שׁ בְּשׁוֹר־וּבַחֲמֹ֖ר יַחְדָּֽו׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תִרְדֵי בְתוֹרָא וּבַחֲמָרָא כַּחֲדָא
verses.en: You may not plow with an ox and with a donkey together.

oe.t: You may not plow with an ox and with a donkey together.

verses.he: לֹ֤א תִלְבַּשׁ֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז צֶ֥מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֖ים יַחְדָּֽו׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תִלְבַּשּׁ שַׁעַטְנֵזָא עֲמַר וְכִתָּן מְחֻבַּר כַּחֲדָא
verses.en: Do not don a mixture of threads, wool and flax together.

oe.t: Do not don a mixture of threads, wool and flax [
combined
] together.

verses.he: גְּדִלִ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֑ךְ עַל־אַרְבַּ֛ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת כְּסוּתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּכַסֶּה־בָּֽהּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: כְּרֻסְפְּדִין תַּעְבֶּד לָךְ עַל אַרְבַּע כַּנְפֵי כְסוּתָךְ דִי תְכַסֵי בַהּ
verses.en: Make yourself pendant threads upon four corners of your garment that you cover with.

oe.t: Make yourself pendant threads upon four corners of your garment that you cover with.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִקַּ֥ח אִ֖ישׁ אִשָּׁ֑ה וּבָ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ וּשְׂנֵאָֽהּ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִסַב גְבַר אִתְּתָא וְיֵעוּל לְוָתַהּ וְיִסְנִנַהּ
verses.en: If a man marries a woman, and he has relations with her and hates her.

oe.t: If a man marries a woman, and he has relations with her and hates her.

verses.he: וְשָׂ֥ם לָהּ֙ עֲלִילֹ֣ת דְּבָרִ֔ים וְהוֹצִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ שֵׁ֣ם רָ֑ע וְאָמַ֗ר אֶת־הָאִשָּׁ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לָקַ֔חְתִּי וָאֶקְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔יהָ וְלֹא־מָצָ֥אתִי לָ֖הּ בְּתוּלִֽים׃
verses.on: וִישַׁוִי לַהּ תַּסְקוֹפֵי מִלִין וְיַפֵּק עֲלַהּ שׁוּם בִּישׁ וְיֵימַר יָת אִתְּתָא הָדָא נְסֵבִית וְעַלִית לְוָתַהּ וְלָא אַשְׁכָּחִית לַהּ בְּתוּלִין
verses.en: Then berates her with calumnies and alleges defamation about her, and he claims, ‘‘I married this woman and was intimate with her, and did not find signs of her virginity.’’

oe.t: Then berates her with calumnies [
libelous words
] and alleges defamation about her, and he claims, ‘‘I married this woman and was intimate with her, and did not find signs of her virginity.’’

verses.he: וְלָקַ֛ח אֲבִ֥י הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה] וְאִמָּ֑הּ וְהוֹצִ֜יאוּ אֶת־בְּתוּלֵ֧י הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָ֛ה] אֶל־זִקְנֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃
verses.on: וְיִסַב אֲבוּהָא (נ''א אֲבוּהִי) דְעוּלֶמְתָּא וְאִמַהּ וְיַפְּקוּן יָת בְּתוּלֵי עוּלֶמְתָּא לָקֳדָם סָבֵי קַרְתָּא לִתְרַע בֵּית דִין אַתְרָא
verses.en: The girl’s father and mother will take and will prove the girl’s virginity to the city judges in the court.

oe.t: The girl’s father and mother will take and will prove the girl’s virginity to [
before
] the city judges in the [
door of the
] court [
of that place

verses.he: וְאָמַ֛ר אֲבִ֥י הנער [הַֽנַּעַרָ֖ה] אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִ֑ים אֶת־בִּתִּ֗י נָתַ֜תִּי לָאִ֥ישׁ הַזֶּ֛ה לְאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיִּשְׂנָאֶֽהָ׃
verses.on: וְיֵימַר אֲבוּהָא דְעוּלֶמְתָּא לְסָבַיָא יָת בְּרַתִּי יְהָבִית לְגַבְרָא הָדֵין לְאִנְתּוּ וּסְנִנַהּ
verses.en: The girl’s father should assert to the judges, ‘‘My daughter did I marry to this man as a wife and he hates her.

oe.t: The girl’s father should assert to the judges, ‘‘My daughter did I marry to this man as a wife and he hates her.

verses.he: וְהִנֵּה־ה֡וּא שָׂם֩ עֲלִילֹ֨ת דְּבָרִ֜ים לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹֽא־מָצָ֤אתִי לְבִתְּךָ֙ בְּתוּלִ֔ים וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּתוּלֵ֣י בִתִּ֑י וּפָֽרְשׂוּ֙ הַשִּׂמְלָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י זִקְנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.on: וְהָא הוּא שַׁוִי תַּסְקוֹפֵי מִלִין לְמֵימַר לָא אַשְׁכָּחִית לִבְרַתָּךְ בְּתוּלִין וְאִלֵין בְּתוּלֵי בְרַתִּי וְיִפְרְסוּן שׁוֹשִׁיפָא קֳדָם סָבֵי קַרְתָּא
verses.en: Look! He has promulgated libelous words, claiming ‘I did not find signs of your daughter’s virginity.’ But this is [the proof of] my daughter’s virginity.’’ And let them spread the cloth before the city judges.

oe.t: Look! He has promulgated libelous words, claiming ‘I did not find signs of your daughter’s virginity.’ But this is [the proof of] my daughter’s virginity.’’ And let them spread the cloth before the city judges.

verses.he: וְלָֽקְח֛וּ זִקְנֵ֥י הָֽעִיר־הַהִ֖וא אֶת־הָאִ֑ישׁ וְיִסְּר֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְיִדְבְּרוּן סָבֵי קַרְתָּא הַהִיא יָת גַבְרָא וְיַלְקוּן יָתֵהּ
verses.en: The judges of that city will take the man and will chastise him.

oe.t: The judges of that city will take the man and will chastise [
whip
] him.

verses.he: וְעָנְשׁ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ מֵ֣אָה כֶ֗סֶף וְנָתְנוּ֙ לַאֲבִ֣י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה כִּ֤י הוֹצִיא֙ שֵׁ֣ם רָ֔ע עַ֖ל בְּתוּלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֽוֹ־תִהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֔ה לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל לְשַּׁלְּחָ֖הּ כָּל־יָמָֽיו׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְיִגְבּוּן מִנֵהּ מְאָה סִלְעִין דִכְסָף וְיִתְּנוּן לַאֲבוּהָא דְעוּלֶמְתָּא אֲרֵי אַפֵּק שׁוּם בִּישׁ עַל בְּתוּלְתָּא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֵהּ תְּהֵי לְאִנְתּוּ לֵית לֵהּ רְשׁוּ לְמִפְטְּרַהּ כָּל יוֹמוֹהִי
verses.en: And they will fine him one hundred silver [shekels] and give [them] to the girl’s father, because he defamed a virgin of Yisroel; and she shall remain his wife, he may not divorce her all his life.

oe.t: And they will fine him one hundred silver [shekels] and give [them] to the girl’s father, because he defamed a virgin of Yisroel; and she shall remain his wife, he may not [
does not have permission
] divorce her all his life.

verses.he: וְאִם־אֱמֶ֣ת הָיָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה לֹא־נִמְצְא֥וּ בְתוּלִ֖ים לנער [לַֽנַּעֲרָֽה׃]
verses.on: וְאִם קֻשְׁטָא הֲוָה פִּתְגָמָא הָדֵין לָא אִשְׁתְּכָחוּ בְתוּלִין לְעוּלֶמְתָּא
verses.en: However, if the allegation is true; signs of the girl’s virginity were not found.

oe.t: However, if the allegation is true; signs of the girl’s virginity were not found.

verses.he: וְהוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת־הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָ֜ה] אֶל־פֶּ֣תַח בֵּית־אָבִ֗יהָ וּסְקָלוּהָ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִירָ֤הּ בָּאֲבָנִים֙ וָמֵ֔תָה כִּֽי־עָשְׂתָ֤ה נְבָלָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִזְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יהָ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְיַפְּקוּן יָת עוּלֶמְתָּא לִתְרַע בֵּית אָבוּהָא וְיִרְגְמֻנַהּ אֱנָשֵׁי קַרְתַּהּ בְּאַבְנַיָא וּתְמוּת אֲרֵי עָבְדַת קְלָנָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְזַנָאָה בֵּית אֲבוּהָא וּתְפַלֵי עָבֵד דְבִישׁ מִבֵּינָךְ
verses.en: They are to take the girl out to the entrance of her father’s home and the people of her city will stone her with stones to death, because she committed a disgraceful act against Yisroel by behaving promiscuously [in] her father’s house; and you will eliminate the evil within you.

oe.t: They are to take the girl out to the entrance of her father’s home and the people of her city will stone her with stones to death, because she committed a disgraceful act against Yisroel by behaving promiscuously [in] her father’s house; and you will eliminate the evil [
doer
] within you.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִמָּצֵ֨א אִ֜ישׁ שֹׁכֵ֣ב ׀ עִם־אִשָּׁ֣ה בְעֻֽלַת־בַּ֗עַל וּמֵ֙תוּ֙ גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם הָאִ֛ישׁ הַשֹּׁכֵ֥ב עִם־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְהָאִשָּׁ֑ה וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִשְׁתְּכַח גְבַר דְשָׁכֵב עִם אִתְּתָא אִתַּת גְבַר וְיִתְקַטְלוּן אַף תַּרְוֵיהוֹן גַבְרָא דְשָׁכֵב עִם אִתְּתָא וְאִתְּתָא וּתְפַלֵי עָבֵד דְבִישׁ מִיִשְׂרָאֵל
verses.en: If a man is found having intercourse with a woman who is the wife of a man, even both of them shall die—the man who had intercourse with the woman and the woman—and you will eliminate the evil from Yisroel.

oe.t: If a man is found having intercourse with a woman who is the wife of a man, even both of them shall die—the man who had intercourse with the woman and the woman—and you will eliminate the evil [
doer
] from Yisroel.

verses.he: כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ נער [נַעֲרָ֣ה] בְתוּלָ֔ה מְאֹרָשָׂ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ וּמְצָאָ֥הּ אִ֛ישׁ בָּעִ֖יר וְשָׁכַ֥ב עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תְהֵי עוּלֶמְתָּא בְתֻלְתָּא דִמְאָרְסָא לִגְבַר וְיַשְׁכְּחִנַהּ גְבַר בְּקַרְתָּא וְיִשְׁכּוּב עִמַהּ
verses.en: If there will be a virgin girl married to a man, and a man encounters her in the city and has intercourse with her,

oe.t: If there will be a virgin girl married to a man, and a man encounters her in the city and has intercourse with her,

verses.he: וְהוֹצֵאתֶ֨ם אֶת־שְׁנֵיהֶ֜ם אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר ׀ הָעִ֣יר הַהִ֗וא וּסְקַלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֥ם בָּאֲבָנִים֮ וָמֵתוּ֒ אֶת־הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ה] עַל־דְּבַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־צָעֲקָ֣ה בָעִ֔יר וְאֶ֨ת־הָאִ֔ישׁ עַל־דְּבַ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־עִנָּ֖ה אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְתַפְּקוּן יָת תַּרְוֵיהוֹן לִתְרַע קַרְתָּא הַהִיא וְתִרְגְמוּן יָתְהוֹן בְּאַבְנַיָא וִימוּתוּן יָת עוּלֶמְתָּא עַל עֵסַק דִי לָא צְוָחַת בְּקַרְתָּא וְיָת גַבְרָא עַל עֵסַק דְעַנִי יָת אִתַּת חַבְרֵהּ וּתְפַלֵי עָבֵד דְבִּישׁ מִבֵּינָךְ
verses.en: You are to take them both out to the court of that city and stone them with stones to death, the girl for the fact that she did not scream in the city and the man for the fact that he oppressed the wife of his peer; and you will eliminate the evil within you.

oe.t: You are to take them both out to the court of that city and stone them with stones to death, the girl for the fact that she did not scream in the city and the man for the fact that he oppressed the wife of his peer; and you will eliminate the evil [
doer
] within you.

verses.he: וְֽאִם־בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה יִמְצָ֣א הָאִ֗ישׁ אֶת־הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָה֙] הַמְאֹ֣רָשָׂ֔ה וְהֶחֱזִֽיק־בָּ֥הּ הָאִ֖ישׁ וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ וּמֵ֗ת הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁכַ֥ב עִמָּ֖הּ לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם בְּחַקְלָא יַשְׁכַּח גְבַר יָת עוּלֶמְתָּא דִמְאָרְסָא וְיִתְקֶף בַּהּ גַבְרָא וְיִשְׁכּוּב עִמַהּ וְיִתְקְטֵּל גַבְרָא דְשָׁכֵב עִמַהּ בִּלְחוֹדוֹהִי
verses.en: But if in the field the man encounters the married girl, and the man holds her and had intercourse with her; then he shall die—only the man who had intercourse with her.

oe.t: But if in the field the man encounters the married girl, and the man holds her and had intercourse with her; then he shall die—only the man who had intercourse with her.

verses.he: ולנער [וְלַֽנַּעֲרָה֙] לֹא־תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דָבָ֔ר אֵ֥ין לנער [לַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה] חֵ֣טְא מָ֑וֶת כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יָק֨וּם אִ֤ישׁ עַל־רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ וּרְצָח֣וֹ נֶ֔פֶשׁ כֵּ֖ן הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.on: וּלְעוּלֶמְתָּא לָא תַעְבֵּד מִדַעַם לֵית לְעוּלֶמְתָּא חוֹבַת דִין דִקְטוֹל אֲרֵי כְּמָא דִיקוּם גַבְרָא עַל חַבְרֵהּ וְיִקְטְּלִנֵהּ נְפַשׁ כֵּן פִּתְגָמָא הָדֵין
verses.en: But to the girl you will not do a thing, the girl has no death liability; for, just as if a man rises up against his peer and murders him, so is this matter.

oe.t: But to the girl you will not do a thing, the girl has no death liability; for, just as if a man rises up against his peer and murders him, so is this matter.

verses.he: כִּ֥י בַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְצָאָ֑הּ צָעֲקָ֗ה הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָה֙] הַמְאֹ֣רָשָׂ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִׁ֖יעַ לָֽהּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי בְחַקְלָא אַשְׁכְּחַהּ צְוָחַת עוּלֶמְתָּא דִמְאָרְסָא וְלֵית דְפָרִיק לַהּ
verses.en: For he encountered her in the field; the married girl screamed, but there was no one to rescue her.

oe.t: For he encountered her in the field; the married girl screamed, but there was no one to rescue her.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִמְצָ֣א אִ֗ישׁ נער [נַעֲרָ֤ה] בְתוּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־אֹרָ֔שָׂה וּתְפָשָׂ֖הּ וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ וְנִמְצָֽאוּ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יַשְׁכַּח גְבַר עוּלֶמְתָּא בְתֻלְתָּא דִי לָא מְאָרְסָא וְיֶחֱדִנַהּ וְיִשְׁכּוּב עִמַהּ וְיִשְׁתַּכְּחוּן
verses.en: If a man encounters a virgin girl who was not married and grabs her and has intercourse with her; and they are discovered.

oe.t: If a man encounters a virgin girl who was not married and grabs her and has intercourse with her; and they are discovered.

verses.he: וְ֠נָתַן הָאִ֨ישׁ הַשֹּׁכֵ֥ב עִמָּ֛הּ לַאֲבִ֥י הנער [הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה] חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלֽוֹ־תִהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֗ה תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִנָּ֔הּ לֹא־יוּכַ֥ל שַׁלְּחָ֖ה כָּל־יָמָֽיו׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְיִתֵּן גַבְרָא דְיִשְׁכֻּב עִמַהּ לַאֲבוּהָא דְעוּלֶמְתָּא חַמְשִׁין סִלְעִין דִכְסַף וְלֵהּ תְּהֵי לְאִנְתּוּ חֳלַף דִי עַנְיַהּ לֵית לֵהּ רְשׁוּ לְמִפְטְרַהּ כָּל יוֹמוֹהִי
verses.en: The man who had intercourse with her must give to the girl’s father fifty silver [shekels]; and she shall be his wife, since he oppressed her; he may not divorce her all his life.

oe.t: The man who had intercourse with her must give to the girl’s father fifty silver [shekels]; and she shall be his wife, since he oppressed her; he may not [
has no permission to
] divorce her all his life.

verses.he: לֹא־יִקַּ֥ח אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יְגַלֶּ֖ה כְּנַ֥ף אָבִֽיו׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא יִסַב גְבַר יָת אִתַּת אֲבוּהִי וְלָא יְגַלֵי כַּנְפָא דַאֲבוּהִי
verses.en: A man may not marry his father’s wife, and may not expose the edge of his father’s garment.

oe.t: A man may not marry his father’s wife, and may not expose the edge of his father’s garment.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יָבֹ֧א פְצֽוּעַ־דַּכָּ֛א וּכְר֥וּת שָׁפְכָ֖ה בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא יִדְכֵּי דְפָסִיק וְדִמְחַבַּל לְמֵעַל בִּקְהָלָא דַיְיָ
verses.en: One may not enter—with injured or crushed genitals or with a gash causing spilling—into Adonoy’s community.

oe.t: One may not [
be “cleansed” to
] enter—with injured or crushed genitals or with a gash causing spilling—into Adonoy’s community.

verses.he: לֹא־יָבֹ֥א מַמְזֵ֖ר בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא־יָ֥בֹא ל֖וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא יִדְכֵּי מַמְזֵרָא לְמֵעַל בִּקְהָלָא דַיְיָ אַף דָרָא עֲשִׂירָאָה לָא יִדְכֵּי לֵהּ לְמֵעַל בִּקְהָלָא דַיְיָ
verses.en: A base-born may not enter into Adonoy’s community, even his tenth generation may not enter into Adonoy’s community.

oe.t: A base-born may not [
be “cleansed” to
] enter into Adonoy’s community, even his tenth generation may not [
“cleanse” him
] enter into Adonoy’s community.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יָבֹ֧א עַמּוֹנִ֛י וּמוֹאָבִ֖י בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא־יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֛ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.on: לָא יִדְכּוּן עַמוֹנָאֵי וּמוֹאָבָאֵי לְמֵעַל בִּקְהָלָא דַיְיָ אַף דָרָא עֲשִׂירָאָה לָא יִדְכֵּי לְהוֹן לְמֵעַל בִּקְהָלָא דַיְיָ עַד עָלָם
verses.en: [Neither] an Ammonite nor a Moavite may enter into Adonoy’s community; even their tenth generation may not enter into Adonoy’s community forever.

oe.t: [Neither] an Ammonite nor a Moavite may [
be “cleansed” to
] enter into Adonoy’s community; even their tenth generation may not [
be “cleansed” to
] enter into Adonoy’s community forever.

verses.he: עַל־דְּבַ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־קִדְּמ֤וּ אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּלֶּ֣חֶם וּבַמַּ֔יִם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁר֩ שָׂכַ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ אֶת־בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֗וֹר מִפְּת֛וֹר אֲרַ֥ם נַהֲרַ֖יִם לְקַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃
verses.on: עַל עֵסַק דִי לָא עֲרָעוּ יָתְכוֹן בְּלַחְמָא וּבְמַיָא בְּאָרְחָא בְּמִפָּקְכוֹן מִמִצְרָיִם וְדִי אֲגַר עֲלָךְ יָת בִּלְעָם בַּר בְּעוֹר מִפְּתוֹר אֲרַם דִי עַל פְּרָת לְלַטָּיוּתָךְ
verses.en: Because of the matter that they did not greet you with bread and water on the way when you came out of Egypt; and because he hired against you Bilam son of Beor from Pesor in Aram Naharayim to curse you.

oe.t: Because of the matter that they did not greet you with bread and water on the way when you came out of Egypt; and because he hired against you Bilam son of Beor from Pesor in Aram Naharayim [
on the river Peras
] to curse you.

verses.he: וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיַּהֲפֹךְ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֧יךָ לְּךָ֛ אֶת־הַקְּלָלָ֖ה לִבְרָכָ֑ה כִּ֥י אֲהֵֽבְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.on: וְלָא אָבֵי יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ לְקַבָּלָא מִן בִּלְעָם וַהֲפַךְ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ לָךְ יָת לְוָטִין לְבִרְכָן אֲרֵי רָחֲמָךְ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ
verses.en: Adonoy, your God, was unwilling to heed Bilam, and Adonoy, your God, turned for you the curse into a blessing, because Adonoy, your God, loved you.

oe.t: Adonoy, your God, was unwilling to heed Bilam, and Adonoy, your God, turned for you the curse[
s
] into a blessing[
s
], because Adonoy, your God, loved you.

verses.he: לֹא־תִדְרֹ֥שׁ שְׁלֹמָ֖ם וְטֹבָתָ֑ם כָּל־יָמֶ֖יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תִתְבַּע שְׁלָמְהוֹן וְטָבָתְהוֹן כָּל יוֹמָיךְ לְעָלָם
verses.en: Do not pursue their peace and their benefit all your life forever.

oe.t: Do not pursue their peace and their benefit all your life forever.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תְתַעֵ֣ב אֲדֹמִ֔י כִּ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ ה֑וּא (ס) לֹא־תְתַעֵ֣ב מִצְרִ֔י כִּי־גֵ֖ר הָיִ֥יתָ בְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.on: לָא תְרַחַק אֱדוֹמָאָה אֲרֵי אֲחוּךְ הוּא לָּא תְרַחַק מִצְרָאָה אֲרֵי דַיָר הֲוֵיתָא בְאַרְעֵהּ
verses.en: Do not despise the Edomite, for he is your brother; do not despise the Egyptian, for you were a stranger in his land.

oe.t: Do not despise [
distance
] the Edomite, for he is your brother; do not despise [
distance
] the Egyptian, for you were a stranger in his land.

verses.he: בָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־יִוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם דּ֣וֹר שְׁלִישִׁ֑י יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: בְּנִין דִי יִתְיְלִידוּ לְהוֹן דָרָא תְלִיתָאָה יִדְכֵּי לְהוֹן לְמֵעַל בִּקְהָלָה דַיְיָ
verses.en: Children who will be born to them, in the third generation, will enter into Adonoy’s community.

oe.t: Children who will be born to them, in the third generation, will [
be “cleansed” to
] enter into Adonoy’s community.

verses.he: כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מַחֲנֶ֖ה עַל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְנִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ מִכֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֥ר רָֽע׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִפּוֹק מַשְׁרִיתָא עַל בַּעֲלֵי דְבָבָךְ וְתִסְתַּמַר מִכֹּל מִדַעַם בִּישׁ
verses.en: When you go out to encamp against your enemies take precautions from every evil thing.

oe.t: When you go out to encamp against your enemies take precautions from every evil thing.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה טָה֖וֹר מִקְּרֵה־לָ֑יְלָה וְיָצָא֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה לֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יְהֵי בָךְ גְבַר דִי לָא יְהֵּי דְכֵי מִקְרֵהּ לֵילְיָא וְיִפּוֹק לְמִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא לָא יֵעוּל לְגוֹ מַשְׁרִיתָא
verses.en: If there is a man among you who is not undefiled [because of] a nocturnal incident; he must go out of the camp, he may not enter into the midst of the camp.

oe.t: If there is a man among you who is not undefiled [because of] a nocturnal incident; he must go out of the camp, he may not enter into the midst of the camp.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֥ה לִפְנֽוֹת־עֶ֖רֶב יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וּכְבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ יָבֹ֖א אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.on: וִיהֵי לְמִפְנֵי רַמְשָׁא יַסְחֵי בְמַיָא וּכְמֵעַל שִׁמְשָׁא יֵעוּל לְגוֹ מַשְׁרִיתָא
verses.en: As sunset nears he is to immerse in water; and after the sun has set he may enter the the midst of the camp.

oe.t: As sunset nears he is to immerse in water; and after the sun has set he may enter the the midst of the camp.

verses.he: וְיָד֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָצָ֥אתָ שָׁ֖מָּה חֽוּץ׃
verses.on: וַאֲתַר מְתַקֵן יְהֵי לָךְ מִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא וְתִפּוֹק תַּמָן לְבָרָא
verses.en: Have a designated place outside the camp, and you will go out there to excrete.

oe.t: Have a designated [
prepared
] place outside the camp, and you will go out there to excrete.

verses.he: וְיָתֵ֛ד תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ עַל־אֲזֵנֶ֑ךָ וְהָיָה֙ בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֣ ח֔וּץ וְחָפַרְתָּ֣ה בָ֔הּ וְשַׁבְתָּ֖ וְכִסִּ֥יתָ אֶת־צֵאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.on: וְסִכְּתָא תְּהֵי לָךְ עַל זֵינָךְ וִיהֵי בְּמִיתְבָךְ לְבָרָא וְתַחְפַּר בַּהּ וּתְתוּב וּתְכַסֵי יָת מִפְּקָתָךְ
verses.en: And a peg are you to have in addition to your weapons; when you need to sit to excrete dig with it, then use it again to cover your excrement.

oe.t: And a peg are you to have in addition to your weapons; when you need to sit to excrete dig with it, then use it again to cover your excrement.

verses.he: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ ׀ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֗ךָ לְהַצִּֽילְךָ֙ וְלָתֵ֤ת אֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה מַחֲנֶ֖יךָ קָד֑וֹשׁ וְלֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת דָּבָ֔ר וְשָׁ֖ב מֵאַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ מְהַלְכָא בְּגוֹ מַשְׁרִיתָךְ לְשֵׁזָבוּתָךְ וּלְמִמְסַר בַּעֲלֵי דְבָבָךְ קֳדָמָךְ וּתְהֵי מַשְׁרִיתָךְ קַדִישָׁא וִלָא יִתְחֲזֵי בָךְ עֲבֵרַת פִּתְגָם וִיתוּב מֵימְרֵהּ מִלְאוֹטָבָא לָךְ
verses.en: For Adonoy, your God, is moving within your camp to save you and to defeat your enemies before you, so your camp must be holy; let Him not see within you disgraceful objects lest He turn away from you.

oe.t: For Adonoy, your God, [
His Shechinah
] is moving within your camp to save you and to defeat your enemies before you, so your camp must be holy; let Him not see within you disgraceful [
offensive
] objects lest He [
His word
] turn away from you [
from benefiting you

verses.he: לֹא־תַסְגִּ֥יר עֶ֖בֶד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁר־יִנָּצֵ֥ל אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵעִ֥ם אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.on: לָא תִמְסַר עֶבֶד עַמְמִין לְיַד רִבּוֹנֵהּ דְיִשְׁתֵּזֵב לְוָתָךְ מִלְוָת רִבּוֹנֵהּ
verses.en: Do not deliver a slave to his master, who escaped to you from his master.

oe.t: Do not deliver a [
foreign
] slave to [
the hand of
] his master, who escaped to you from his master.

verses.he: עִמְּךָ֞ יֵשֵׁ֣ב בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ בַּמָּק֧וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֛ר בְּאַחַ֥ד שְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ בַּטּ֣וֹב ל֑וֹ לֹ֖א תּוֹנֶֽנּוּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: עִמָךְ יִתֵּב בֵּינָךְ בְּאַתְרָא דִי יִתִּרְעֵי בַּחֲדָא מִן קִרְוָיךְ בִּדְיֵיטַּב לֵהּ לָא תוֹנִנֵהּ
verses.en: With you will he live among you, in the place that he chooses in any of your cities, wherever it is good for him; do not distress him.

oe.t: With you will he live among you, in the place that he chooses in any of your cities, wherever it is good for him; do not distress him.

verses.he: לֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה קְדֵשָׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה קָדֵ֖שׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.on: לָא תְהֵי אִתְּתָא מִבְּנַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לִגְבָר עָבֵד וְלָא יִסַב גַבְרָא מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתְּתָא אָמָא
verses.en: There is not to be a harlot from the daughters of Yisroel; and there shall not be a male prostitute from the sons of Yisroel.

oe.t: There is not to be a [
woman
] harlot from the daughters of Yisroel [
to a man slave
]; and there shall not be a [
man
] male prostitute from the sons of Yisroel [
to a woman servant

verses.he: לֹא־תָבִיא֩ אֶתְנַ֨ן זוֹנָ֜ה וּמְחִ֣יר כֶּ֗לֶב בֵּ֛ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְכָל־נֶ֑דֶר כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.on: לָא תָעֵל אֲגַר זַנִיתָא וְחוּלְפַן כַּלְבָא לְבֵית מַקְדְשָׁא דַיְיָ אֱלָהָךְ לְכָל נִדְרָא אֲרֵי מְרָחָק קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ אַף תַּרְוֵיהוֹן
verses.en: Do not bring a harlot’s fee or payment for a dog to the house of Adonoy, your God, in fulfillment of any vow; because Adonoy, your God’s abominations are even both of them.

oe.t: Do not bring a harlot’s fee or payment for a dog to the house of Adonoy, your God, in fulfillment of any vow; because [
distanced from
] Adonoy, your God’s abominations are even both of them.

verses.he: לֹא־תַשִּׁ֣יךְ לְאָחִ֔יךָ נֶ֥שֶׁךְ כֶּ֖סֶף נֶ֣שֶׁךְ אֹ֑כֶל נֶ֕שֶׁךְ כָּל־דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּֽׁךְ׃
verses.on: לָא תְרַבֵּי לַאֲחוּךְ רִבִּית כְּסַף רִבִּית עִבוּר רִבִּית כָּל מִדַעַם דְמִתְרַבֵּי
verses.en: You may not pay usury to your brother, usury on money, usury on food; usury on any matter where it is paid.

oe.t: You may not pay usury to your brother, usury on money, usury on food; usury on any matter where it is paid.

verses.he: לַנָּכְרִ֣י תַשִּׁ֔יךְ וּלְאָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תַשִּׁ֑יךְ לְמַ֨עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֜ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֔ךָ עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: לְבַר עַמְמִין תְּרַבֵּי וְלַאֲחוּךְ לָא תְרַבֵּי בְּדִיל דִיבָרֵכִנָךְ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ בְּכֹל אוֹשָׁטוּת יְדָךְ עַל אַרְעָא דִי אַתְּ עָלֵל:לתַמָן לְמֵירְתַהּ
verses.en: You may pay usury to the stranger, but to your brother do not pay usury; in order that Adonoy, your God, will bless you in all your commerce on the land that you are coming there to inherit.

oe.t: You may pay usury to the stranger [
foreigner
], but to your brother do not pay usury; in order that Adonoy, your God, will bless you in all your commerce on the land that you are coming there to inherit.

verses.he: כִּֽי־תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֙דֶר֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תְאַחֵ֖ר לְשַׁלְּמ֑וֹ כִּֽי־דָּרֹ֨שׁ יִדְרְשֶׁ֜נּוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִדַר נְדַר קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ לָא תְאַחַר לְשַׁלָמוּתֵהּ אֲרֵי מִתְבַּע יִתְבְּעִנֵהּ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ מִנָךְ וִיהֵי בָךְ חוֹבָא
verses.en: If you make a vow to Adonoy, your God, do not delay in discharging it; for Adonoy, your God, will surely demand it from you, and you will be at fault.

oe.t: If you make a vow to [
before
] Adonoy, your God, do not delay in discharging it; for Adonoy, your God, will surely demand it from you, and you will be at fault.

verses.he: וְכִ֥י תֶחְדַּ֖ל לִנְדֹּ֑ר לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תִתִּמְנַע לְמִנְדַר לָא יְהֵי בָךְ חוֹבָא
verses.en: But if you desist from vowing, no fault will be found with you.

oe.t: But if you desist from vowing, no fault will be found with you.

verses.he: מוֹצָ֥א שְׂפָתֶ֖יךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר וְעָשִׂ֑יתָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֜רְתָּ לַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ נְדָבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּפִֽיךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אַפָּקוּת סִפְוָתָךְ תִּטַר וְתַעְבֵּד כְּמָא דִי נְדַרְתָּא קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ נְדַבְתָּא דִי מַלֶלְתָּא בְּפוּמָךְ
verses.en: Keep what you have articulated; and perform whatever you vow; to Adonoy, your God, voluntarily—whatever you say with your mouth.

oe.t: Keep what you have articulated; and perform whatever you vow; to [
before
] Adonoy, your God, voluntarily—whatever you say with your mouth.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תָבֹא֙ בְּכֶ֣רֶם רֵעֶ֔ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֧ עֲנָבִ֛ים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ֖ שָׂבְעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶֽל־כֶּלְיְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתֵּֽן׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִתָּגַר בְּכַרְמָא דְחַבְרָךְ וְתֵיכוּל עִנְבִין כְּנַפְשָׁךְ שִׂבְעָךְ וּלְמָאנָךְ לָא תִתֵּן
verses.en: When you enter your fellow’s vineyard, you may eat grapes as you desire, to your satisfaction; but you may not place it in your container.

oe.t: When you [
are hired to
] enter your fellow’s vineyard, you may eat grapes as you desire, to your satisfaction; but you may not place it in your container.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תָבֹא֙ בְּקָמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֔ךָ וְקָטַפְתָּ֥ מְלִילֹ֖ת בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְחֶרְמֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָנִ֔יף עַ֖ל קָמַ֥ת רֵעֶֽךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִתָּגַר בְּקַמְתָא דְחַבְרָךְ וְתִקְטוֹף מְלִילָן בִּידָךְ וּמַגְלָא לָא תְרִים עַל קַמְתָא דְחַבְרָךְ
verses.en: When you enter your fellow’s standing grainstalks, you may cut off stalks by hand, but do not lift a sickle over your fellow’s standing grainstalks.

oe.t: When you [
are hired to
] enter your fellow’s standing grainstalks, you may cut off stalks by hand, but do not lift a sickle over your fellow’s standing grainstalks.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִקַּ֥ח אִ֛ישׁ אִשָּׁ֖ה וּבְעָלָ֑הּ וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־לֹ֧א תִמְצָא־חֵ֣ן בְּעֵינָ֗יו כִּי־מָ֤צָא בָהּ֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת דָּבָ֔ר וְכָ֨תַב לָ֜הּ סֵ֤פֶר כְּרִיתֻת֙ וְנָתַ֣ן בְּיָדָ֔הּ וְשִׁלְּחָ֖הּ מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִסַב גְבַר אִתְּתָא וְיִבְעֲלִנַהּ וִיהֵי אִם לָא תַשְׁכַּח רַחֲמִין בְּעֵינוֹהִי אֲרֵי אַשְׁכַּח בַּהּ עֲבֵרַת פִתְגָם וְיִכְתּוֹב לַהּ גֵט פִּטוּרִין וִיהַב בִּידַהּ וְיִפְטְּרִנַהּ מִבֵּיתֵהּ
verses.en: If a man marries a woman and consummates with her; should she not find favor in his eyes because he found in her something lecherous, he is to write for her a document of severance and place [it] in her hand and send her from his home.

oe.t: If a man marries a woman and consummates with her; should she not find favor in his eyes because he found in her something lecherous [
sinful
], he is to write for her a document of severance and place [it] in her hand and send her from his home.

verses.he: וְיָצְאָ֖ה מִבֵּית֑וֹ וְהָלְכָ֖ה וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְאִישׁ־אַחֵֽר׃
verses.on: וְתִפּוֹק מִבֵּיתֵהּ וּתְהַךְ וּתְהֵי לִגְבַר אָחֳרָן
verses.en: If she leaves his home and goes and becomes [wife] to another man.

oe.t: If she leaves his home and goes and becomes [wife] to another man.

verses.he: וּשְׂנֵאָהּ֮ הָאִ֣ישׁ הָאַחֲרוֹן֒ וְכָ֨תַב לָ֜הּ סֵ֤פֶר כְּרִיתֻת֙ וְנָתַ֣ן בְּיָדָ֔הּ וְשִׁלְּחָ֖הּ מִבֵּית֑וֹ א֣וֹ כִ֤י יָמוּת֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הָאַחֲר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־לְקָחָ֥הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.on: וְיִסְנִנַהּ גַבְרָא בַתְרָאָה וְיִכְתּוֹב לַהּ גֵטּ פִטּוּרִין וְיִתֵּן בִּידַהּ וְיִפְטְרִנַהּ מִבֵּיתֵהּ אוֹ אֲרֵי יְמוּת גַבְרָא בַתְרָאָה דְנָסְבַהּ לֵה לְאִנְתּוּ
verses.en: If her last husband hates her and writes for her a document of severance and places [it] in her hand and sends her from his house, or if the latter man dies, who had taken her as his wife;

oe.t: If her last husband hates her and writes for her a document of severance and places [it] in her hand and sends her from his house, or if the latter man dies, who had taken her as his wife;

verses.he: לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל בַּעְלָ֣הּ הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן אֲשֶֽׁר־שִׁ֠לְּחָהּ לָשׁ֨וּב לְקַחְתָּ֜הּ לִהְי֧וֹת ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַחֲרֵי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻטַּמָּ֔אָה כִּֽי־תוֹעֵבָ֥ה הִ֖וא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תַחֲטִיא֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: לֵית לֵהּ רְשׁוּ לְבַעֲלַהּ קַדְמָאָה דִי פָטְרַהּ לְמִתֻּב לְמִסְבַהּ לְמֶהֱוֵי לֵהּ לְאִנְתּוּ בָּתַר דִי אִסְתָּאָבַת אֲרֵי מְרָחָקָא הִיא קֳדָם יְיָ וְלָא תְחַיַב יָת אַרְעָא דִי יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ יָהֵב לָךְ אַחֲסָנָא
verses.en: Her first husband who divorced her may not remarry her to be his wife after her having been defiled, for it is an abomination before Adonoy; and you are not to make liable the land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you as territory.

oe.t: Her first husband who divorced her may not [
has no permission to
] remarry her to be his wife after her having been defiled, for it is an abomination before Adonoy; and you are not to make liable the land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you as territory.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִקַּ֥ח אִישׁ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה לֹ֤א יֵצֵא֙ בַּצָּבָ֔א וְלֹא־יַעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֖יו לְכָל־דָּבָ֑ר נָקִ֞י יִהְיֶ֤ה לְבֵיתוֹ֙ שָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְשִׂמַּ֖ח אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־לָקָֽח׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִסַב גְבַר אִתְּתָא חַדְתָּא לָא יִפּוֹק בְּחֵילָא וְלָא יֵעִבַר עֲלוֹהִי לְכָל מִדָעַם פָּנֵי יְהֵי לְבֵיתֵהּ שַׁתָּא חֲדָא וְיַחְדֵי יָת אִתְּתֵהּ דִי נְסַב
verses.en: When a man marries a new wife, he is not to be mobilized into the army, it shall not impose itself over him in any matter; he shall be free for his home one year and he shall bring joy to the wife he married.

oe.t: When a man marries a new wife, he is not to be mobilized into the army, it shall not impose itself over him in any matter; he shall be free for his home one year and he shall bring joy to the wife he married.

verses.he: לֹא־יַחֲבֹ֥ל רֵחַ֖יִם וָרָ֑כֶב כִּי־נֶ֖פֶשׁ ה֥וּא חֹבֵֽל׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא יִסַב מַשְׁכּוֹנָא רֵחַיָא וְרִכְבָּא אֲרֵי בְהוֹן מִתְעֲבֵד מָזוֹן לְכָל נְפַשׁ
verses.en: He may not secure as collateral a mortar or pestle, for his is taking life as security.

oe.t: He may not secure as collateral a mortar or pestle, for his is taking life as security [
for sustinance is made with these for all souls

verses.he: כִּי־יִמָּצֵ֣א אִ֗ישׁ גֹּנֵ֨ב נֶ֤פֶשׁ מֵאֶחָיו֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִתְעַמֶּר־בּ֖וֹ וּמְכָר֑וֹ וּמֵת֙ הַגַּנָּ֣ב הַה֔וּא וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִשְׁתְּכַח גְבַר גָנֵב נַפְשָׁא מֵאֲחוֹהִי מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִתָּגַר בֵּהּ וִיזַבְּנִנֵהּ וְיִתְקְטֵל גַנָבָא הַהוּא וּתְפַלֵי עָבֵד דְבִישׁ מִבֵּינָךְ
verses.en: If a man is apprehended having kidnaped a person from his brothers, from the descendants of Yisroel, and he exploited him and sold him; that kidnaper is to be put to death and you will eliminate the evil within you.

oe.t: If a man is apprehended having kidnaped a person from his brothers, from the descendants of Yisroel, and he exploited him and sold him; that kidnaper is to be put to death and you will eliminate the evil [
doer
] within you.

verses.he: הִשָּׁ֧מֶר בְּנֶֽגַע־הַצָּרַ֛עַת לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹ֖ד וְלַעֲשׂ֑וֹת כְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר־יוֹר֨וּ אֶתְכֶ֜ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים הַלְוִיִּ֛ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖ם תִּשְׁמְר֥וּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ (ס)
verses.on: אִסְתַּמַר בְּמַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ לְמִטַּר לַחֲדָא וּלְמֶעְבָּד כְּכֹל דִי יַלְפוּן יָתְכוֹן כָּהֲנַיָא לֵוָאֵי כְּמָא דִי פַקֶדְתִּנוּן תִּטְרוּן לְמֶעְבָּד
verses.en: Take precautions with the leprosy affliction to be extremely careful and to do—in accordance with everything that the kohanim the Levites shall instruct you; as I commanded them are you to make sure to do.

oe.t: Take precautions with the leprosy affliction to be extremely careful and to do—in accordance with everything that the kohanim the Levites shall instruct you; as I commanded them are you to make sure to do.

verses.he: זָכ֕וֹר אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְמִרְיָ֑ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֥ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ (ס)
verses.on: הֱוֵי דְכִיר יָת דִי עֲבַד יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ לְמִרְיָם בְּאָרְחָא בְּמִפָקְכוֹן מִמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Remember what Adonoy, your God, did to Miriam on the way when you were going out of Egypt.

oe.t: Remember what Adonoy, your God, did to Miriam on the way when you were going out of Egypt.

verses.he: כִּֽי־תַשֶּׁ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ מַשַּׁ֣את מְא֑וּמָה לֹא־תָבֹ֥א אֶל־בֵּית֖וֹ לַעֲבֹ֥ט עֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תַרְשֵׁי בְחַבְרָךְ רְשׁוּ מִדָעַם לָא תֵעוּל לְבֵיתֵהּ לְמִסַב מַשְׁכּוֹנֵהּ
verses.en: If you become your fellow’s creditor for any amount of debt, do not enter his house to take his pledge.

oe.t: If you become your fellow’s creditor for any amount of debt, do not enter his house to take his pledge [
collateral

verses.he: בַּח֖וּץ תַּעֲמֹ֑ד וְהָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ נֹשֶׁ֣ה ב֔וֹ יוֹצִ֥יא אֵלֶ֛יךָ אֶֽת־הַעֲב֖וֹט הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.on: בְּבָרָא תְּקוּם וְגַבְרָא דִי אַתְּ רָשֵׁי בֵהּ יַפֵק לְוָתָךְ יָת מַשְׁכּוֹנָא לְבָרָא
verses.en: Stand outside, and the man from whom you are claiming, will bring out the pledge to you outside.

oe.t: Stand outside, and the man from whom you are claiming, will bring out the pledge [
collateral
] to you outside.

verses.he: וְאִם־אִ֥ישׁ עָנִ֖י ה֑וּא לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב בַּעֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם גְבַר מִסְכֵּן הוּא לָא תִשְׁכּוּב בְּמַשְׁכּוֹנֵהּ
verses.en: And if he is a poor man, do not repose with his collateral [in your possession].

oe.t: And if he is a poor man, do not repose with his collateral [in your possession].

verses.he: הָשֵׁב֩ תָּשִׁ֨יב ל֤וֹ אֶֽת־הַעֲבוֹט֙ כְּבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְשָׁכַ֥ב בְּשַׂלְמָת֖וֹ וּבֵֽרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וּלְךָ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה צְדָקָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אָתָבָא תָתֵב לֵהּ יָת מַשְׁכּוֹנָא כְּמֵעַל שִׁמְשָׁא וְיִשְׁכּוּב בִּכְסוּתֵהּ וִיבָרֵכִנָךְ וְלָךְ תְּהֵי זְכוּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ
verses.en: Return are you to return the pledge to him at sunset, and he will sleep with his garment and bless you; and it will be to your credit before Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: Return are you to return the pledge [
collateral
] to him at sunset, and he will sleep with his garment and bless you; and it will be to your credit [
merit
] before Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לֹא־תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק שָׂכִ֖יר עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מֵאַחֶ֕יךָ א֧וֹ מִגֵּרְךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאַרְצְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.on: לָא תַעֲשׁוֹק אֲגִירָא עַנְיָא וּמִסְכֵּנָא מֵאַחָיךְ אוֹ מִגִיוֹרָךְ דִי בְאַרְעָךְ בְּקִרְוָיךְ
verses.en: Do not steal from the wage earner who is poor or destitute; from your brothers or your converts who are in your land in your cities.

oe.t: Do not steal from the wage earner who is poor or destitute; from your brothers or your converts who are in your land in your cities.

verses.he: בְּיוֹמוֹ֩ תִתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָר֜וֹ וְֽלֹא־תָב֧וֹא עָלָ֣יו הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֤י עָנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵלָ֕יו ה֥וּא נֹשֵׂ֖א אֶת־נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִקְרָ֤א עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃ (ס)
verses.on: בְּיוֹמֵהּ תִּתֵּן אַגְרֵהּ וְלָא תֵעוּל עֲלוֹהִי שִׁמְשָׁא אֲרֵי עַנְיָא הוּא וְלֵהּ הוּא מְסַר יָת נַפְשֵׁהּ וְלָא יִקְרֵי עֲלָךְ קֳדָם יְיָ וִיהֵי בָךְ חוֹבָא
verses.en: On its day give his wage and let the sun not set upon it, for he is a poor man, and he places his life in jeopardy for it; [so that] he should not complain about you to Adonoy, and you will have a sin.

oe.t: On its day give his wage and let the sun not set upon it, for he is a poor man, and he places his life in jeopardy for it; [so that] he should not complain about you to [
before
] Adonoy, and you will have a sin.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יוּמְת֤וּ אָבוֹת֙ עַל־בָּנִ֔ים וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־יוּמְת֣וּ עַל־אָב֑וֹת אִ֥יש בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יוּמָֽתוּ׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא יְמוּתוּן אֲבָהָן עַל פּוּם בְּנִין וּבְנִין לָא יְמוּתוּן עַל פּוּם אֲבָהָן אֱנַשׁ בְּחוֹבֵהּ יְמוּתוּן
verses.en: Fathers shall not be executed through sons, and sons shall not be executed through fathers; each to be executed for his sin.

oe.t: Fathers shall not be executed through [
by the mouths of
] sons, and sons shall not be executed through [
by the mouths of
] fathers; each to be executed for his sin.

verses.he: לֹ֣א תַטֶּ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט גֵּ֣ר יָת֑וֹם וְלֹ֣א תַחֲבֹ֔ל בֶּ֖גֶד אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.on: לָא תַצְלֵי דִין גִיוֹרָא וְיִתַּמָא וְלָא תִסַב מַשְׁכּוֹנָא לְבוּשׁ אַרְמְלָא
verses.en: Do not be devious in the judgment of the proselyte or orphan; and you may not secure as collateral, a widow’s garment.

oe.t: Do not be devious in [
forcibly wrench
] the judgment of the proselyte or orphan; and you may not secure as collateral, a widow’s garment.

verses.he: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֙יתָ֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִשָּׁ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְתִדְכַּר אֲרֵי עַבְדָא הֲוֵיתָא בְּמִצְרַיִם וּפָרְקָךְ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ מִתַּמָן עַל כֵּן אֲנָא מְפַקְדָךְ לְמֶעְבַּד יָת פִּתְגָמָא הָדֵין
verses.en: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Adonoy, your God, redeemed you from there; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.

oe.t: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Adonoy, your God, redeemed you from there; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.

verses.he: כִּ֣י תִקְצֹר֩ קְצִֽירְךָ֨ בְשָׂדֶ֜ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֧ עֹ֣מֶר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה לֹ֤א תָשׁוּב֙ לְקַחְתּ֔וֹ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֑ה לְמַ֤עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תַחְצוֹד חֲצָדָךְ בְּחַקְלָךְ וְתִנְשֵׁי עֻמְרָא בְחַקְלָא לָא תְתוּב לְמִסְבֵהּ לְגִיוֹרָא לְיִתַּמָא וּלְאַרְמְלָא יְהֵי בְּדִיל דִיבָרֵכִנָךְ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ בְּכֹל עוֹבָדֵי יְדָךְ
verses.en: When you reap your reaping in your field, and you forget a sheaf in the field, you may not return to take it; for the proselyte, for the orphan, and for the widow let it be; in order that Adonoy, your God, will bless you in all your endeavors.

oe.t: When you reap your reaping in your field, and you forget a sheaf in the field, you may not return to take it; for the proselyte, for the orphan, and for the widow let it be; in order that Adonoy, your God, will bless you in all your endeavors.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תַחְבֹּט֙ זֵֽיתְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְפָאֵ֖ר אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲרֵי תַחְבּוֹט זֵיתָךְ לָא תְפַלֵי בַּתְרָךְ לְגִיוֹרָא לְיִתַּמָא וּלְאַרְמְלָא יְהֵי
verses.en: When you harvest your olive tree, you may not strip it of its glory behind you. for the proselyte, for the orphan, and for the widow let it be.

oe.t: When you harvest your olive tree, you may not strip it of its glory behind you. for the proselyte, for the orphan, and for the widow let it be.

verses.he: כִּ֤י תִבְצֹר֙ כַּרְמְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְעוֹלֵ֖ל אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי תִקְטוֹף כַּרְמָךְ לָא תְעָלֵל בַּתְרָךְ לְגִיוֹרָא לְיִתַּמָא וּלְאַרְמְלָא יְהֵי
verses.en: When you harvest your vineyard you may not harvest pygmy vines behind you; for the proselyte, for the orphan, and for the widow let it be.

oe.t: When you harvest your vineyard you may not harvest pygmy vines behind you; for the proselyte, for the orphan, and for the widow let it be.

verses.he: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי־עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְתִדְכַּר אֲרֵי עַבְדָא הֲוֵיתָא בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם עַל כֵּן אֲנָא מְפַקְדָךְ לְמֵעְבַּד יָת פִּתְגָמָא הָדֵין
verses.en: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.

oe.t: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; that is why I am commanding you to do this thing.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה רִיב֙ בֵּ֣ין אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְנִגְּשׁ֥וּ אֶל־הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט וּשְׁפָט֑וּם וְהִצְדִּ֙יקוּ֙ אֶת־הַצַּדִּ֔יק וְהִרְשִׁ֖יעוּ אֶת־הָרָשָֽׁע׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יְהֵי דִין בֵּין גֻבְרַיָא וְיִתְקָרְבוּן לְדִינָא וִידוּנֻנוּן וִיזַכּוּן יָת זַכָּאָה וִיחַיְבוּן יָת חַיָבָא
verses.en: If a quarrel should occur among men and they bring it to court and they judge them and they determine who is righteous and they convict the villain.

oe.t: If a quarrel [
lawsuit
] should occur among men and they bring it to court and they judge them and they determine who is righteous and they convict the villain.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֛ה אִם־בִּ֥ן הַכּ֖וֹת הָרָשָׁ֑ע וְהִפִּיל֤וֹ הַשֹּׁפֵט֙ וְהִכָּ֣הוּ לְפָנָ֔יו כְּדֵ֥י רִשְׁעָת֖וֹ בְּמִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.on: וִיהֵי אִם בַּר חַיָבָא לְאַלְקָאָה חַיָבָא וְיִרְמִנֵהּ דַיָנָא וְיַלְקִנֵהּ קֳדָמוֹהִי כְּמִסַת חוֹבְתֵהּ בְּמִנְיָן
verses.en: Should the wicked one deserve flogging, the judge shall incline him and have him flogged before him in the amount befitting his crime, with the number near.

oe.t: Should the wicked one deserve flogging, the judge shall incline him and have him flogged before him in the amount befitting his crime, with the number near.

verses.he: אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יַכֶּ֖נּוּ לֹ֣א יֹסִ֑יף פֶּן־יֹסִ֨יף לְהַכֹּת֤וֹ עַל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ מַכָּ֣ה רַבָּ֔ה וְנִקְלָ֥ה אָחִ֖יךָ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: אַרְבְּעִין יַלְקִנֵהּ לָא יוֹסֵף דִילְמָא יוֹסֵף לְאַלְקָיוּתֵהּ עַל אִלֵין מָחָא רַבָּא וְיֵקַל אֲחוּךְ לְעֵינָיךְ
verses.en: Forty is he to have him flogged, he may not add; lest he additionally flog him over these, a great flogging, when your brother will be slighted before you.

oe.t: Forty is he to have him flogged, he may not add; lest he additionally flog him over these, a great flogging, when your brother will be slighted before you.

verses.he: לֹא־תַחְסֹ֥ם שׁ֖וֹר בְּדִישֽׁוֹ׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא תֵחוֹד פּוּם תּוֹרָא בִּדְיָשֵׁהּ
verses.en: You may not muzzle an ox while it threshes.

oe.t: You may not muzzle [
the mouth of
] an ox while it threshes.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יֵשְׁב֨וּ אַחִ֜ים יַחְדָּ֗ו וּמֵ֨ת אַחַ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ וּבֵ֣ן אֵֽין־ל֔וֹ לֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֧ה אֵֽשֶׁת־הַמֵּ֛ת הַח֖וּצָה לְאִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר יְבָמָהּ֙ יָבֹ֣א עָלֶ֔יהָ וּלְקָחָ֥הּ ל֛וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֖ה וְיִבְּמָֽהּ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יֵתְבוּן אַחִין כַּחֲדָא וִימוּת חַד מִנְהוֹן וּבַר לֵית לֵהּ לָא תְהֵי אִתַּת מֵתָנָא לְבָרָא לִגְבַר אוֹחֲרָן יְבָמַהּ יֵעוּל עֲלַהּ וְיִסְבַהּ לֵהּ לְאִנְתּוּ וְיִבְּמַהּ
verses.en: If brothers reside together, and one of them dies having no son, let the wife of the dead man not marry outside [the family] to a strange man; her brother-in-law will consummate with her thus marrying her to be his wife, and perform levirate marriage with her.

oe.t: If brothers reside together, and one of them dies having no son, let the wife of the dead man not marry outside [the family] to a strange man; her brother-in-law will consummate with her thus marrying her to be his wife, and perform levirate marriage with her.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֗ה הַבְּכוֹר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד יָק֕וּם עַל־שֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו הַמֵּ֑ת וְלֹֽא־יִמָּחֶ֥ה שְׁמ֖וֹ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.on: וִיהֵי בּוּכְרָא דִי תְלִיד יְקוּם עַל שְׁמָא דַאֲחוּהִי מֵתָנָא וְלָא יִתִּמְחֵי שְׁמֵהּ מִיִשְׂרָאֵל
verses.en: It shall be that the firstborn, when she is capable of bearing children, shall be established in place of his deceased brother, so that his name may not be obliterated from Yisroel.

oe.t: It shall be that the firstborn, when she is capable of bearing children, shall be established in place of his deceased brother, so that his name may not be obliterated from Yisroel.

verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֤א יַחְפֹּץ֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ לָקַ֖חַת אֶת־יְבִמְתּ֑וֹ וְעָלְתָה֩ יְבִמְתּ֨וֹ הַשַּׁ֜עְרָה אֶל־הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים וְאָֽמְרָה֙ מֵאֵ֨ין יְבָמִ֜י לְהָקִ֨ים לְאָחִ֥יו שֵׁם֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה יַבְּמִֽי׃
verses.on: וְאִם לָא יִצְבֵי גַבְרָא לְמִסַב יָת יְבִמְתֵּהּ וְתִסַק יְבִמְתֵהּ לִתְרַע בֵּית דִינָא לָקֳדָם סָבַיָא וְתֵימַר לָא צָבֵי יְבָמִי לַאֲקָמָא לַאֲחוּהִי שְׁמָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לָא אָבֵי לְיַבָּמוּתִי
verses.en: But if the man will not want to marry his sister-in-law; his sister-in-law must go up to the portal, to the judges, and say, ‘‘My brother-in-law refuses to establish for his brother a name in Yisroel; he is unwilling to do perform levirate marriage with me.’’

oe.t: But if the man will not want to marry his sister-in-law; his sister-in-law must go up to the portal [
of the court
], to [
before
] the judges, and say, ‘‘My brother-in-law refuses [
does not agree
] to establish for his brother a name in Yisroel; he is unwilling to do perform levirate marriage with me.’’

verses.he: וְקָֽרְאוּ־ל֥וֹ זִקְנֵי־עִיר֖וֹ וְדִבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֑יו וְעָמַ֣ד וְאָמַ֔ר לֹ֥א חָפַ֖צְתִּי לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.on: וִיקְרוּן לֵהּ סָבֵי קַרְתֵּהּ וִימַלְלוּן עִמֵהּ וִיקוּם וְיֵימַר לָא רְעֵנָא לְמִסְבַהּ
verses.en: The judges of his city will call him and converse with him. He shall stand and say, ‘‘I do not want to marry her.’’

oe.t: The judges of his city will call him and converse with him. He shall stand and say, ‘‘I do not want to marry her.’’

verses.he: וְנִגְּשָׁ֨ה יְבִמְתּ֣וֹ אֵלָיו֮ לְעֵינֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִים֒ וְחָלְצָ֤ה נַעֲלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְל֔וֹ וְיָרְקָ֖ה בְּפָנָ֑יו וְעָֽנְתָה֙ וְאָ֣מְרָ֔ה כָּ֚כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יִבְנֶ֖ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית אָחִֽיו
verses.on: וְתִתְקְרַב יְבִמְתֵּהּ לְוָתֵה לָקֳדָם סָבַיָא וְתַשְׁרֵי סֵינֵהּ מֵעַל רַגְלֵהּ וְתֵרוֹק בְּאַנְפּוֹהִי וְתָתֵב וְתֵימַר כְּדֵין יִתְעֲבֵד לִגְבַר דִי לָא יִבְנֵי יָת בֵּיתָא דַאֲחוּהִי
verses.en: And his sister-in-law will approach him in the sight of the judges, and she will remove his shoe from upon his foot, and spit before him; and she will say aloud, ‘‘This is done to the man who will not build his brother’s family.’’

oe.t: And his sister-in-law will approach him in the sight of the judges, and she will remove his shoe from upon his foot, and spit before him; and she will say aloud, ‘‘This is done to the man who will not build his brother’s family.’’

verses.he: וְנִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֵּ֖ית חֲל֥וּץ הַנָּֽעַל׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְיִתְקְרֵי שְׁמֵהּ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בֵּית שְׁרִי סֵינָא
verses.en: And it will be entitled in Yisroel, the house of the divestiture of the shoe.

oe.t: And it will be entitled in Yisroel, the house of the divestiture of the shoe.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יִנָּצ֨וּ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים יַחְדָּו֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְאָחִ֔יו וְקָֽרְבָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לְהַצִּ֥יל אֶת־אִישָׁ֖הּ מִיַּ֣ד מַכֵּ֑הוּ וְשָׁלְחָ֣ה יָדָ֔הּ וְהֶחֱזִ֖יקָה בִּמְבֻשָֽׁיו׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִנְצוּן גֻבְרִין כַּחֲדָא גְבַר וַאֲחוּהִי וְתִתְקְרֵב אִתַּת חַד לְשֵׁזָבָא יָת בַּעֲלַהּ מִיַד מָחוּהִי וְתוֹשֵׁט יְדַהּ וְתִתְקֵף בְּבֵית בַּהֲתְּתֵהּ
verses.en: If men engage in an altercation—a man and his brother—and the wife of one approaches to save her husband from his assailant, and she puts out her hand and grasps his genitals,

oe.t: If men engage in an altercation—a man and his brother—and the wife of one approaches to save her husband from his assailant, and she puts out her hand and grasps his genitals [
the place of his shame

verses.he: וְקַצֹּתָ֖ה אֶת־כַּפָּ֑הּ לֹ֥א תָח֖וֹס עֵינֶֽךָ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וּתְקוּץ יָת יְדַהּ לָא תְחוּס עֵינָךְ
verses.en: You shall sever her hand; you are not to have compassion.

oe.t: You shall sever her hand; you are not to have compassion.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ בְּכִֽיסְךָ֖ אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֖ה וּקְטַנָּֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: לָא יְהֵי לָךְ בְּכִיסָךְ מַתְקַל וּמַתְקָל רַבְּתָא וּזְעֶרְתָּא
verses.en: You are not to have for yourself in your pouch varying weight-stones, large and small.

oe.t: You are not to have for yourself in your pouch varying weight-stones, large and small.

verses.he: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה גְּדוֹלָ֖ה וּקְטַנָּֽה׃
verses.on: לָא יְהֵי לָךְ בְּבֵיתָךְ מְכִילָא וּמְכִילָא רַבְּתָא וּזְעֶרְתָּא
verses.en: You shall not have in your house varying measures, large and small.

oe.t: You shall not have in your house varying measures, large and small.

verses.he: אֶ֣בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֤ה וָצֶ֙דֶק֙ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֔ךְ אֵיפָ֧ה שְׁלֵמָ֛ה וָצֶ֖דֶק יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑ךְ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יַאֲרִ֣יכוּ יָמֶ֔יךָ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃
verses.on: מַתְקִלִין שָׁלְמִין דִקְשׁוֹט יְהוֹן לָךְ מְכִילָן שָׁלְמִין דִקְשׁוֹט יְהוֹן לָךְ בְּדִיל דְיוֹרְכוּן יוֹמָיךְ עַל אַרְעָא דַיְיָ אֱלָהָךְ יָהֵב לָךְ
verses.en: A fully accurate, just weight, you shall have, you are to have whole and honest measures; in order that you live long on the land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you.

oe.t: A fully accurate, just weight, you shall have, you are to have whole and honest measures; in order that you live long on the land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you.

verses.he: כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כָּל־עֹ֣שֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה כֹּ֖ל עֹ֥שֵׂה עָֽוֶל׃ (פ)
verses.on: אֲרֵי מְרָחָק קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלהָךְ כָּל עָבֵד אִלֵין כֹּל עָבֵד שְׁקַר
verses.en: Because Adonoy, your God’s abomination, are all who do these [things]; all who do falsehood.

oe.t: Because [
distanced from before
] Adonoy, your God’s abomination, are all who do these [things]; all who do falsehood.

verses.he: זָכ֕וֹר אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ עֲמָלֵ֑ק בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֥ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.on: הֲוֵי דְכִיר יָת דִי עֲבַד לָךְ עֲמָלֵק בְּאָרְחָא בְּמִפָּקְכוֹן מִמִצְרָיִם
verses.en: Remember what Amalek perpetrated against you on the way when you were going out of Egypt.

oe.t: Remember what Amalek perpetrated against you on the way when you were going out of Egypt.

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָֽרְךָ֜ בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ וַיְזַנֵּ֤ב בְּךָ֙ כָּל־הַנֶּחֱשָׁלִ֣ים אַֽחַרֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּ֖ה עָיֵ֣ף וְיָגֵ֑עַ וְלֹ֥א יָרֵ֖א אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.on: דִי עָרְעָךְ בְּאָרְחָא וְקָטֵל בָּךְ כָּל דַהֲווֹ מִתְאַחֲרִין בַּתְרָךְ וְאַתְּ מְשַׁלְהֵי וְלָאֵי וְלָא דָחֵיל מִן קֳדָם יְיָ
verses.en: When they chanced upon you en route struck down your appendage—all the feeble ones behind you—and you were exhausted and wearied, and they had no fear of God.

oe.t: When they chanced upon [
overtook
] you en route struck down [
killed
] your appendage—all the feeble ones behind you—and you were exhausted and wearied, and they had no fear of [
before
] God.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֡ה בְּהָנִ֣יחַ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ ׀ לְ֠ךָ מִכָּל־אֹ֨יְבֶ֜יךָ מִסָּבִ֗יב בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָֽה־אֱ֠לֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵ֨ן לְךָ֤ נַחֲלָה֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ תִּמְחֶה֙ אֶת־זֵ֣כֶר עֲמָלֵ֔ק מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לֹ֖א תִּשְׁכָּֽח׃ (פ)
verses.on: וִיהֵי כַּד יְנִיחַ יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ לָךְ מִכָּל בַּעֲלֵי דְבָבָךְ מִסְחוֹר סְחוֹר בְּאַרְעָא דִי יְיָ אֱלָהָךְ יָהֵב לָךְ אַחֲסָנָא לְמֵירְתַהּ תִּמְחֵי יָת דוּכְרָנָא דַעֲמָלֵק מִתְּחוֹת שְׁמַיָא לָא תִּתִּנְשֵׁי
verses.en: When Adonoy, your God, has given you repose from all your enemies around, in the land that Adonoy, your God, is giving you as territory to inherit, you shall obliterate the memory of Amalek from beneath the sky; do not forget.
